body.error: This project records its product as a biologic, and Module 3 is composed here only for a drug (a small-molecule medicinal product). A biologic's quality requirements are ICH Q6B, Q5A(R2) and Q5C and its cell-bank sections; a device or IVD files no CTD Module 3 at all. Author its quality content in Document editor & authoring, keep the evidence in Vault (DMS), and file it through the Submission center.
